en: 1 John 2

p.src: 1  My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

ja: どもたちよ、あなたがたが
きます。しかし、だれかが
なる方、イエス・キリストです。
en: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
u.src: 1  My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

ja: 2:1 ギリシャ語のπαρακλητονは、「助言者」「助け主」「仲裁者」「弁護者」「慰め主」という意味を持つ。
en: 2:1 Greek παρακλητον: Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, and Comforter.

p.src: 2  And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

ja: を贖ういけにえ です。
のためのいけにえです。
en: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
u.src: 2  And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

ja: 2:2 「罪を贖ういけにえ」はギリシャ語のιλασμοςから来ており、神の怒りをなだめるもの、またはその手段、すなわち私たちの罪のために神の怒りを取り去るいけにえを意味する。
en: 2:2 “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin.

p.src: 3  This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

ja: っているなら、それによって
en: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
u.src: 3  This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

p.src: 4  One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

en: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
u.src: 4  One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

p.src: 5  But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

ja: しかし、この方のことばを
うされています。それによって、
のうちにいることが分かります。
en: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
u.src: 5  But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

p.src: 6  he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

ja: のうちにとどまっていると
en: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
u.src: 6  he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

p.src: 7  Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

ja: めではなく、あなたがたが
en: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
u.src: 7  Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

p.src: 8  Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

ja: いています。この戒めは、この
においても、あなたがたにおいても
en: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
u.src: 8  Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

p.src: 9  He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

en: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
u.src: 9  He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

p.src: 10  He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

ja: には、つまずきとなるものがありません。
en: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
u.src: 10  He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

p.src: 11  But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

ja: をくらませたからです。
en: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
u.src: 11  But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

p.src: 12  I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

ja: のゆえに、あなたがたの
en: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
u.src: 12  I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

p.src: 13  I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

en: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
u.src: 13  I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

p.src: 14  I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

ja: いたのは、あなたがたが
のことばがあなたがたのうちにとどまり、あなたがたが
zh: 為你們認識父。 父老啊，我曾寫信給你們， 因為
en: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
u.src: 14  I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

p.src: 15  Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

en: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
u.src: 15  Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

p.src: 16  For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

ja: にあるすべてのもの、すなわち
en: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
u.src: 16  For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

p.src: 17  The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

en: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
u.src: 17  The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

p.src: 18  Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

ja: れています。このことによって、
en: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
u.src: 18  Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

p.src: 19  They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

ja: してはいませんでした。もし
たちとともにとどまっていたはずです。しかし
らかになるためでした。
en: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
u.src: 19  They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

p.src: 20  You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

ja: がれており、皆、知識を持っています。
en: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
u.src: 20  You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

ja: 2:20 別訳「真実なことを知っています」、または「すべてのことを知っています」。
en: 2:20 Or, “know what is true”, or, “know all things”

p.src: 21  I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

ja: らないからではありません。あなたがたが
en: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
u.src: 21  I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

p.src: 22  Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

ja: とは、イエスがキリストであることを
のほかに、だれでしょう。この
キリスト、父と御子を否定する者です。
en: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
u.src: 22  Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

p.src: 23  Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

en: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
u.src: 23  Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

ja: 2:23 多数本文は「御子を告白する者は、父をも持っています」を省いている。
en: 2:23 MT omits: He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

p.src: 24  Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

ja: ですから、あなたがたは、
のうちにとどめなさい。それがあなたがたのうちにとどまるなら、あなたがたも
のうちにとどまります。
en: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
u.src: 24  Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

p.src: 25  This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

ja: これこそ、この方が私たちに
en: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
u.src: 25  This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

p.src: 26  These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

ja: わそうとする者たちについて、私はこれらのことを書きました。
en: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
u.src: 26  These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

p.src: 27  As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

ja: あなたがたについて言えば、この方から
ぎがあなたがたのうちにとどまっているので、だれかに
ぎが、すべてのことについてあなたがたを
りではありません。それが教えたとおり、あなたがたはこの方のうちにとどまるでしょう。
en: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
u.src: 27  As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

p.src: 28  Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

ja: どもたちよ、この方のうちにとどまりなさい。そうすれば、この方が
じることがありません。
en: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
u.src: 28  Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

en: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
